name: AlphaHook3Pct
mechanic: Dynamic LP fee from 0.30% to 3.00%, driven by volatility and volume EMAs.
plain: A fee hook for BSC token/stablecoin pools. It moves the LP fee between 0.30% and 3.00% from exponential moving averages of volatility and volume, and seeds new pools at the fee ceiling.
rules: The fee is driven by volatility and volume EMAs, not set by hand.
